PDF page rendered and visually inspected 2026-11-02

mechanics.onInstallation: Select two talents from Droid Commander prestige class
mechanics.talentUse: Operator may use selected talents as though possessed while operating station
mechanics.usageAuthority: Usage limits calculated per station, not per operator; swapping operators does not restore uses

source.verification: PDF page rendered and visually inspected 2026-11-02
PDF page rendered and visually inspected 2026-11-02

mechanics.droidPoolConnection: Pool droid must have comlink, integrated comlink, or remote processor
mechanics.stationIntelligence: 14 or starship Intelligence, whichever is greater

functions.check: No check for familiar task / associated trained skill; unusual task may require Use Computer at GM discretion

functions.effect: Each assisting droid contributes +3 rather than +2 and automatically succeeds in aid checks

functions.precondition: Droid has tracking device or trackable restraining bolt; within station operational range (typically vessel or facility)

functions.ruleReference: Core Rulebook p.192; either remote or direct connection

Never let locate reveal an untracked droid or one beyond station range.
Remote reprogramming must respect Core rules and permission state.
